theNewBlocker.summary: The stamp the walk wanted now exists on every row, but the walk is still red: the same 16 account-keyed nodes that used to fail BP-PUBLISH-RUN-01 now fail S13, because a facts-free retirement payload has no `provenance.parcelSource` and the next token in S13's reach is a mirrored zoning REFUSAL OBJECT, which S13 stringifies and rejects as off-allowlist.
rootCauseChain: 1. The retirement payload (buildAccountKeyedRetirementPayload, accountKeyedWork.ts) is facts-free and sets provenance = { tierNote, roadsPending } -- no parcelSource, no landUseSource, no zoningSource (omission is the honest shape: a retired account has no parcel source).

2. `zoningSourceMirror` (LDT artifacts/api-server/src/lib/structuralFactToFacetsWire.ts:102-145) mirrors the node's zoning rail onto provenance.zoningSource -- deliberately and with a docstring saying so ('This leaf never decides anything. It COPIES ... if the rail refuses, the twin refuses'). For an account-keyed node the rail carries no parcel_record cityLimits cell, so the rail is a serve-composed REFUSAL OBJECT and the mirror copies that object.

3. `servedProvenanceTokens` (factory src/stages/grade/s-rules.mjs:700-704) takes the first of provenance.parcelSource / landUseSource / zoningSource, filtering only `t != null && t !== false` -- so a non-string REFUSAL OBJECT is accepted as a 'provenance token'. On a normal node `parcelSource = "conformant-v1-cad-parcel-roll"` (on the allowlist) is chosen first and S13 passes; on a facts-free retired node there is no parcelSource, so the refusal object becomes tokens[0].
4. `gradeS13` (s-rules.mjs:627-658) stringifies it and tests it against DEFAULT_PROVENANCE_ALLOWLIST -> FAIL ('is placeholder or off the allowlist').

5. `walkParcel` (verify-walk.mjs) promotes that S13 FAIL over the retirement grade, because the retirement branch returns verdict 'pass' (grade 'RETIRED') and the promotion only tests `grade.verdict === 'pass'`. Final grade becomes S13, which is exactly why retiredCount is 0 even though all 16 carry earned, current-run-stamped retirements.
theNewBlocker.evidenceThatTheRetirementItselfWasAdmitt: The served body for 48209:84629 (GET https://smart-site-factory.vercel.app/site/api/spine/cortex/api/brokerage/v1/place/node/48209:84629/facets) carries facets.publishRunId = b0864dde-3e9f-43b4-bf14-49174abfea23 AND facets.recordRetirement = {status 'retired', verdict 'absent-verified', authority/scopeSearched/asOf/basis all non-empty, lastSeenTaxYear 2025} -- i.e. a well-formed retirement by the very predicate the walk imports (isEarnedRecordRetirement, LDT recordRetirement.ts:41). The walk's retirement branch admits it; S13 is what then replaces the grade.
theNewBlocker.whyThisIsNotThisPassesFault: The pass did what A-146 option B ruled: current run stamp, no facts. The object in the token position is produced downstream (the mirror copying a refusal rail), and it is rejected by a *rule*, not by a data defect.
theNewBlocker.whyTheOldGreenWalkWasGreen: Walk 91c3bfd5 (2026-09-14T03:36:42Z, pass, 96 parcels, retiredCount 16) graded its retired nodes RETIRED because those pre-P-180 payloads still carried the normal bake's provenance including an allowlisted parcelSource, so S13 never failed. Its retired block (48209:135540-135573) does not even appear in the later 86-parcel sweeps. The green was therefore incidental to retired nodes still carrying fact-shaped payloads -- the very condition P-180 option B removes.
theNewBlocker.whyUnmeasuredWouldBeEnough: isNonPassGrade (src/stages/grade/v-rules.mjs:74) is true ONLY for FAIL and KNOWN_OPEN; UNMEASURED is not a non-pass grade, and gradeS13 already returns unmeasured('S13', ...) when no token is supplied. So an S13 that measured no token would leave these 16 graded RETIRED and the walk green -- consistent with retiredCount 16 on the pre-P-180 walk.

operatorGate.requestText: OPERATOR REQUEST (step 3 -> step 4). The P-180 walk fix (LDT #686, merge 84f4e7c9, all checks pass; factory pin #147, merge db3aa54c, all checks pass) works as ruled: staging 48209 tier-1 is now a single uniform run -- 173,050 rows at publishRunId b0864dde-3e9f-43b4-bf14-49174abfea23, exactly the required count -- and BP-PUBLISH-RUN-01 is now 0 occurrences (was 16). The staging walk is nevertheless RED: 16 account-keyed parcels fail S13, 'provenance <mirrored zoning refusal object> is placeholder or off the allowlist'. The cause is not the retirement pass: a facts-free retirement payload has no provenance.parcelSource, so S13's token selection reaches the zoning REFUSAL OBJECT that zoningSourceMirror copies onto provenance.zoningSource, and S13 stringifies and rejects it. The fix is therefore in the WALK'S RULE (servedProvenanceTokens accepting a non-string as a token, and/or walkParcel promoting an S-family failure over a RETIRED grade), which this dispatch places out of scope ('Do not weaken the walk'; Out of scope: 'The walk's rule'). I have not touched it. DECISION NEEDED: (a) rule that an S13 with no measured token is UNMEASURED rather than FAIL (isNonPassGrade already treats UNMEASURED as acceptable, and gradeS13 already emits UNMEASURED when no token is supplied), and/or (b) rule that walkParcel does not promote an S-family failure over a RECORD_RETIRED grade -- a retired node is not a served claim, which is the walk's own retiredCount/servedCount doctrine; and (c) authorise the production publish (step 4) once green.
leastChangeOptionsForRuling: (a) servedProvenanceTokens: accept only string tokens (it already filters null/false) so a mirrored refusal object yields no token -> S13 UNMEASURED -> not a failure -> the 16 grade RETIRED. Smallest change; keeps S13's allowlist semantics intact for actual tokens.
(b) walkParcel: skip the S-family promotion when grade.grade === RECORD_RETIRED ('RETIRED'), matching the documented disjoint-class doctrine.

(c) Neither: if S13 firing on a mirrored refusal is intended, then a facts-free retirement payload can never walk green and the P-180 ruling needs revisiting -- note there is NO honest in-lane fix: setting provenance.parcelSource to an allowlisted token would fabricate a parcel source for a node that has none, and the mirror overwrites zoningSource regardless of what the payload sets.

`rg -r` is a REPLACE flag, not a recursive flag, in this environment: `rg -rn "S13" src/` silently rewrote every match to the replacement string. Recursion is implicit via the path argument; use `rg -n`.
